meta.defaultDescription: Importer and distributor of food, packaging and hygiene products for professionals across Tunisia. Established 1985.

hero.title: Professional solutions for foodservice and industry.
hero.lead: Importer and distributor of food, MONIN beverage, packaging and hygiene solutions for professionals across Tunisia.
hero.sceneAlt: Abstract composition of three forms representing the company's food, packaging and hygiene divisions.
hero.mediaAlt: An animated selection of professional products from the Catering catalogue.

showcase.title: Four expert universes. One trusted supplier.
showcase.lead: Move directly from the products you need to the right formats, availability and professional offer.

benefits.title: Built around professional purchasing.
benefits.lead: A practical partner for the products your team uses every day.

range.title: One multi-category range
range.body: Food, beverages, packaging and hygiene products sourced through one professional contact.

formats.title: Formats made for service
formats.body: Professional pack sizes selected for restaurants, hotels, retail and industrial operations.

advice.title: Human product guidance
advice.body: Tell us your use case and our team will help identify the relevant range, format and alternative.

distribution.title: Local commercial follow-up
distribution.body: A Tunisia-based team for availability, quotations and the practical details of your order.

offers.title: Our current offers.
offers.lead: See live promotions and offers that are coming soon.

industries.title: Built for professional buyers.
industries.lead: Our clients operate across food service, retail, healthcare and industry. Each has different requirements — and draws on different parts of our range.

brands.title: International sourcing.
brands.lead: We represent selected international manufacturers in Tunisia.

contact.title: Tell us what your operation needs.
contact.lead: Tell us what you need and we will come back to you with availability, formats and pricing.

food.title: Sauces that hold up to the heat.
food.body: Ketchup, barbecue sauces and condiments in professional formats. Selected to stay consistent from the first cover of a service to the last.
food.mediaAlt: A gourmet burger beside a professional-format jar of mayonnaise.

monin.title: A drinks menu that holds all year.
monin.body: MONIN syrups, frappé bases and bar ingredients. Enough to build a menu your team executes the same way at every service.
monin.mediaAlt: MONIN syrup poured into an iced glass with lime and mint.

packaging.title: Your product deserves its presentation.
packaging.body: Verrines, cups, trays and polycarbonate glassware. Packaging decides what the customer sees before they taste anything.
packaging.mediaAlt: A layered dessert served in a clear verrine on dark stone.

hygiene.title: The protocol starts before service.
hygiene.body: Coats, hair nets, masks, gloves and overshoes. The disposable range a professional kitchen goes through every day.
hygiene.mediaAlt: A translucent disposable professional coat hanging in clean light.

statement.thesis: We do not manufacture. We select.
statement.body: Since 1985, Société Ferid Khemakhem has imported and distributed the food, packaging and hygiene supplies that Tunisia's professional kitchens run on. Our trade is the choice itself: finding, checking and carrying the products a kitchen can rely on.

sectors.title: Tell us what you run. We know what it consumes.
